item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the subtropical ridge extending westwards gradually, the weather will be generally fine and persistently very hot over Guangdong for the rest of this week. However, a southerly airstream will bring a few showers to the coastal areas in the next couple of days. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central to northern parts of the South China Sea early next week. There will be thunderstorms and more showers over the coast of Guangdong.
